Sommaire**Sommaire du projet SPACE ACADEMY**

Space Academy est une plateforme éducative interactive dédiée à l'apprentissage de l'astronomie et à l'exploration spatiale. Elle permet aux utilisateurs de découvrir le système solaire en 3D, de suivre des cours sur l'espace, de répondre à des quiz et de participer à des simulations de missions spatiales telles que l'atterrissage lunaire, les opérations de sauvetage et l'exploration avec un rover.

Développée avec Python, Django, JavaScript et Three.js, la plateforme associe apprentissage scientifique, visualisation 3D et expériences interactives afin de rendre les sciences spatiales plus accessibles, particulièrement aux jeunes et aux étudiants.
details:
SPACE ACADEMY – Project Details

Space Academy is an interactive educational platform designed to make space science more accessible and engaging. It allows learners to explore the Solar System in 3D, study astronomy through educational lessons, test their knowledge with quizzes, and experience simulated space missions.

The platform includes an interactive 3D Solar System featuring eight planets, moons and orbital paths. Users can explore celestial bodies and access astronomy learning content covering the Sun, planets, moons, asteroids, comets, meteorites and space exploration.

Space Academy also offers simulated Apollo mission experiences, including the Apollo 11 lunar landing, Apollo 12 precision landing, Apollo 13 rescue, Apollo 14 exploration and Apollo 15 rover mission. Player profiles and progress tracking help users follow their learning and mission activities.

The project was developed using Python and Django for the backend, JavaScript for interactive functionality, and Three.js for 3D visualization.

The main goal is to transform space education from a primarily passive learning experience into an interactive journey where learners can explore, understand and practise scientific concepts.

Space Academy is an independent educational project and is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
